summary: KKR & Co. Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Stipulation and Order with the DOJ Antitrust Division to resolve a civil antitrust complaint regarding HSR premerger notification requirements for 2021-2022 affiliate transactions. The subsidiary will pay $250.0 million, subject to court approval; the DOJ terminated related investigations. The company states the penalty will be fully reimbursed by outside law firms. This is a regulatory settlement, not a special situation transaction or capital markets event, so it does not qualify for any special-situation category.
